notes: An engine question that needs an answer now appears in Apex, on the website too, with the same buttons and fields: the join delay is a number box with quick picks, and Yes/No boxes are Yes/No buttons. Nobody has to be at the machine: an unanswered question is answered with its safe default (Cancel or No) after 20 seconds, and a box that asks to back up a file before a reset is answered Yes. The engine's second Delete Accounts confirmation is answered Yes after Apex's own confirmation. A whole number too large for the engine is no longer written into a setting.
